explanation: The killing took away the king who had backed the dictatorship and the heir who had been trained to succeed him, and left the throne to an eighteen-year-old with no standing of his own. What the monarchy lost was not a battle but the capacity to have one fought for it: its defenders spent the next thirty-two months in ministries too short-lived to govern, while the republican movement had been shown that the regime could be struck at directly and survived the striking. The revolution of October 1910 was made against a dynasty that had already been broken in the Terreiro do Paço.
